name: slack
description: Slack: read channels and threads, search messages and post messages through an own Slack app. Needs the bot token (xoxb-) of that app; search needs an optional user token.

tools.name: slack_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Slack connection and show the workspace and the bot name.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels the app can see (id, name, member). Optional name filter.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Read the latest messages of a channel the app is a member of.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Read the replies of one thread.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across the workspace (needs the optional user token).

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a channel, or as a reply when thread_ts is given (this posts to Slack for everyone in the channel). Ask the person before using it.

slack_bot_token.title: Bot User OAuth Token
slack_bot_token.description: api.slack.com/apps, your app, OAuth & Permissions, Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…). Scopes: channels:read, groups:read, channels:history, groups:history, chat:write. Stored as a secret.

slack_user_token.title: User token for search (optional)
slack_user_token.description: Optional. User OAuth Token (xoxp-…) with scope search:read. Without it, search is off.
